title: Swiss vote on electronic identity cards for second time
summary: The proposal was revised after voters rejected the idea in 2021 amid concerns over data protection.

title: Moldova heads to the polls in tense vote that could steer country closer to EU or Russia
summary: President Maia Sandu says parliamentary vote is Moldova’s ‘most consequential election’ and warns against falling deeper into Moscow’s orbit Moldovans began voting on Sunday in parliamentary elections that could see the country neighbouring Ukraine swerve from its pro-European path towards Moscow, with the government and the EU accusing Russia of “deeply interfering”. Moldova, an EU candidate country, has long been divided over closer ties with Brussels or maintaining Soviet-era relations with Moscow. Continue reading...

title: UN imposes 'snapback' sanctions on a hungrier, poorer and more anxious Iran
summary: The United Nations reimposed sanctions on Iran early Sunday over its nuclear program, further squeezing the Islamic Republic as its people increasingly find themselves priced out of the food they need to survive and worried about their futures.

title: Israeli team out of top Italian cycling race over Gaza war protest concerns
summary: Italian race organiser says there is high possibility of race disruption due to participation of Israeli team.
